claims: "Plátano Power" was popularized by the Dominican Republic team during the 2013 World Baseball Classic.
"Plátano Power" was frequently used in 2026 as the Dominican Republic team dominates the competition.
Pitcher Fernando Rodney introduced "Plátano Power" during the 2013 World Baseball Classic to represent the Dominican Republic team.
The plantain is a staple food for the working class in the Dominican Republic.
"Plátano Power" has been adopted for clothing such as T-shirts highlighting Dominican pride and DNA.
"Plátano Power" clothing is worn at baseball games and cultural events.
"Plátano Power" merchandise is available on Amazon.com.
The term "Plátano Power" is distinct from the Platanares geothermal power plant in Honduras.
The Platanares geothermal power plant is in Honduras
